findings.title: Local issuer mints agent tokens for any customer_id with no credential; an agent token then acts as that customer
findings.description: POST /api/v1/auth/test-session with app_role=agent skips the identity lookup and signs whatever customer_id the body carries (existing or not, probe B7: ZZZ-NOBODY got 200), with ttl_seconds up to 86400. The resulting token carries app_metadata = {customer_id: <chosen>, app_role: agent}. get_current_session only rejects tokens that are neither agent nor carry a customer_id, so this agent token passes every customer endpoint: probe B3/B4 started a conversation and filed a dispute as CLI-FIX-OTHER (201, then AUTONOMOUS_RESOLUTION with a case id) and the same token opened the console (B5, 200). In development mode, which is what Dockerfile and docker-compose ship, anyone reaching the API becomes an agent and any customer at once.
